sections.title: Build a simple order
sections.content: Use *quiero*, food and drink vocabulary, and quantities to make a clear café order. You can connect two items with *y*.

items.english: I would like a coffee, please.

items.spanish: Quiero un té y un sándwich.
items.english: I would like a tea and a sandwich.

items.spanish: Un café y una ensalada, por favor.
items.english: A coffee and a salad, please.

sections.content: Keep an order simple and clear. Start with *quiero* or give the item directly, then add *por favor* when appropriate.
